notes.title: Upcoming Full Release & Pricing Model Update
notes.content:
Dear early Tennis Life players,

Thank you so much for your support of Tennis Life. As the full version of the game—featuring player development and club management elements—is approaching release, we are planning to change the game’s pricing model to Free to Play.

This change will take place after the “Racing Fest” event ends next week.

For our existing players, your access and gameplay rights will remain completely unaffected. The SenseDevil team is sincerely grateful for your early support!
